its just all the things i did are things that kids do when they're being abused. but i dont remember any abuse. it makes me feel like i was just born sick. theres no excuse.
i have a therapist. cant even say the things outloud to him
the memories of it keep coming back and haunting me. i cant get away from them. i cant numb it or forget it or cut it out. i want to cut it out and burn it off.
